# Reifiable contexts with closed exceptions

Owned static factories use one result-only Object formal and fixed receiver/Method/array contexts. The inputs supply no generic binding or returned-value evidence. Both varargs and fixed-array entries retain two closed runtime exception declarations, their actual provider result and all original callbacks and casts.

Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every generated Java unit, compare every original definition and supported metadata, Exceptions and runtime role, and use frozen external callers and observers. Fresh JVM cases check context/array identity, ignored calls, partial effects, reentrant writes, exact failures and later result casts. Wrong programs run before recovery; Signature-only controls preserve original Code.

`--protected-provider` compiles an owned fixed-array variant with protected static entries. It retains the same independent observers, original metadata accounting and Signature-only controls. The public varargs and fixed-array profiles remain separate compiler inputs.
